claim: Head-on/side-on daylight head crop while eating at bunk: ears carried upright/alert, no ear droop; eye clear, no ocular discharge visible; nose buried in feed so nasal discharge not assessable

Breathing rate 23/min across 7 valid windows (I0001), below herd mean range; no open-mouth/extended-neck/flank-heave posture seen in any daylight frame. High breathing_effort amplitude z (+2.7) not corroborated by rate and likely a close-bunk pixel-scale artifact.
Head crop at bunk, head down eating, green ear tag confirms COW_02. Ears carried upright/normal, no droop. Nose/eyes not clearly assessable at this head-down eating angle.

Head crops at bunk (I0031, I0033) show cow feeding head-down into feed; no nasal discharge visible on the resolvable muzzle in I0031, but ears/eyes not cleanly resolvable and no standing head-up daylight view obtained. Head posture signs not assessable.

longest_meal_gap_min 600 is not sustained: 6h trend CUSUM never crossed, cow tracks herd band, and feed_response shows prompt bunk arrival (0-3 min) and normal stays (11-32 min) at most herd rushes. Appetite looks normal.

Head crops (I0041 facing-toward, I0042 side-on) show the cow with head down eating at the bunk in a normal feeding posture; muzzle in feed. Eyes, nose and ears are not clearly resolved at these angles/mud, so discharge and ear detail are not assessable. No head_low-while-standing observed.
COW_05 side-on at bunk feeding, head down to eat (normal), ears relaxed/upright with no droop, no visible discharge; eyes/nose partly obscured by feeding angle
